name: Esheru
source:
"I want to go along with her, I want to be Thumbelina's power!!"

On a stormy night she saved a prince and fell in love with him. A mermaid princess who traded her voice for legs.
She wants to know about the outside world more and be helpful to Thumbelina so she goes along on the journey.
She's sensitive to other people's pain and has a kind heart.
